description: This PHP class 'ReviewerDecorator' is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the entity decorator namespace. It wraps a 'Reviewer' entity and provides methods to access and modify reviewer-related data, including setting an associated employee by employee number.

classes.name: ReviewerDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for the Reviewer entity, enabling modification and retrieval of reviewer data with additional helper functions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Reviewer instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the reviewer by employee number, using a reference obtained via ORM helper.
